name: transfer_funds
goal_template: Log in with the credentials provided. Check that account {from_account} has enough balance to cover {amount}, then transfer {amount} from account {from_account} to account {to_account}. Confirm the transfer went through. Report the confirmation message, the new balance of account {from_account}, and the transaction ID of the transfer you just made, looked up in the transactions of account {from_account}.

source_balance_before.description: The balance of account {from_account} before the transfer.

confirmation_text.description: The confirmation message shown after the transfer. If the message is split across several elements, record each part under this name.

new_balance.description: The balance of account {from_account} after the transfer.

transaction_id.description: The transaction ID of the transfer just made. Optional: if it cannot be found after a genuine search, skip it.
